verdict.rationale: LibreOffice is an office suite, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an official MCP server. Headless mode, UNO accept strings and the SDK/API are developer building blocks an integrator could use to build one, not an MCP server shipped by the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
